analysis.easyExplanation: 데이터사이언스학과(학부) 및 통계데이터사이언스학과(대학원) 사무실의 위치와 연락처, 운영시간을 안내하는 공지입니다. 사무실은 60주년기념관 909호에 있으며 학기 중 평일 09시부터 18시까지(점심시간 12:00~13:00 제외) 운영합니다. 이메일로 문의할 때는 반드시 학번과 이름을 함께 적어 보내야 합니다.

en.title: Information on Department Office Contact Information and Operating Hours
summary: Department of Data Science (undergraduate) and Department of Statistics and Data Science (graduate) office is located in Room 909 of the 60th Anniversary Memorial Hall (60주년기념관 909호).
Contact: Tel 032-860-9201, Email choijs@inha.ac.kr (Student ID and name must be included when inquiring via email).
Operating hours during the semester are 09:00–18:00 (Lunch break 12:00–13:00).

Operating hours during vacation: 09:00–17:00 during summer/winter sessions and the week before semester opening, and 09:00–16:00 after session completion (Lunch break 12:00–13:00; closes early at 15:00 on Family Day, the 3rd Friday of every month).
If you did not receive a reply to an email inquiry sent before October 1, please resend the email.
en.easyExplanation: This notice provides the location, contact details, and operating hours for the Department of Data Science (undergraduate) and Department of Statistics and Data Science (graduate) office. The office is located in Room 909 of the 60th Anniversary Memorial Hall and is open weekdays 09:00 to 18:00 during the semester (except lunch break 12:00–13:00). Please remember to include your student ID and name whenever you send an email inquiry.
en.target: Department of Data Science (undergraduate), Department of Statistics and Data Science (graduate)
